content: {"reasoning":"Authorization was required, retroactive authorization and peer-to-peer review are unavailable, and the prior necessity appeal did not resolve CO-197. CO-197 assigns contractual responsibility to the provider; the deductible and coinsurance do not independently establish patient liability for this denied service, and the rare historical patient-billing success does not justify transferring that balance.
